propositions: Production bugs result from store write paths bypassing canonical write seams via raw 'git add/commit/rm' operations, including in workflow YAML
Two sanctioned write seams exist: the store seam (gitutil.run_git/run_git_write, event_append._run_git, txn, purge_bridge internals) and the reconciler seam (git_adapter, _ref_lock)

A two-layer deterministic CI lint must flag raw git mutations in Python (AST-based, intra-function argv tracking) and in workflows/shell (cwd-aware tracker-context detection), silenced only by inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' markers
The lint bootstrap report mode identifies all current raw-git hits (seam internals, maintenance commands, disposable-workspace sites), each remediated or marked before enforcement activation

Lint failure teaches that store writes must use event-append/transaction APIs or reconciler git_adapter, preventing new bypasses through deterministic scanning of literal and local-variable argv construction
